_readme: Every photo and clip the site can show. The site reads this file; tools/media/encode.py writes to it.
This repo is public: no grower names, internal notes or exact locations in here. 'site' is the public label, e.g. 'Okanagan vineyard'.
labels: none = raw footage | hand = boxes or labels a person drew | model-reviewed = model output a person checked | model-unreviewed = never shown on the live site.
public: only true once the clip has passed ILR preflight. encode.py never sets it.
status: pending = a slot the site expects, not yet cut | ready = files exist.
category: cart | gophers | stakes | canopy. feature:false keeps a clip out of the homepage tabs; in_log:false keeps it off /field-log/.
Run: python3 tools/media/check_clips.py before every push.
